req.title: Login required for delete
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they POST /<id>/delete.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that anonymous users should be redirected to the login page when attempting to delete a post. This behavior ensures that only authenticated users can perform delete operations, maintaining security and data integrity. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of this requirement.

tests.name: test_delete_post_redirects_anonymous_user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_delete_post_as_authenticated_user
preconditions: User is logged in as James
actions: Delete a post authored by James
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_delete_post_boundary_case
preconditions: User is logged in as Rahul
actions: Attempt to delete a post not authored by Rahul
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
r = client.post('/7/delete')
assert r.status_code == 403
